item.title: Cabinet Member Updates Residents on Midlothian Pothole Repair Progress
item.description: Residents concerned about the condition of roads across Midlothian have been given an update on the progress of pothole repairs. The Cabinet Member for Roads acknowledged the poor state of many roads, resulting from historic backlogs and years of underinvestment. item.title: Councillors Tour Midlothian’s New Green-Energy Housing Developments
item.description: Ward councillors from Gorebridge and Bonnyrigg joined Midlothian Council’s Cabinet Member for Housing, Councillor Stuart McKenzie, to tour two flagship green-energy housing developments currently under construction in Midlothian.
